info.description: A card with image, icon badge, and text overlay

backgroundImage.description: Main background image for the card

iconImage.description: Small icon/avatar image to display in the circle badge

iconEmoji.description: Alternative to icon image - use an emoji or icon character

badgeText.description: Text to display next to the icon (e.g., '+$210.10')

badgeColor.description: Background color for the badge (hex code)

badgePosition.description: Position of the badge overlay on the image

overlayText.description: Optional overlay text at the bottom

overlayColor.description: Background color for the overlay text (hex code)

overlayIcon.description: Icon or emoji to show before overlay text (e.g., '✓')
